rationale: The proposal resolves both prior blocking deficiencies by enforcing safe-integer bounds (0 <= stopEpoch <= 2^53-1) with fail-closed exhaustion in the canonical serializer and schema, while establishing kernel SO_PEERCRED exact-UID authorization against a root-owned policy with strictly zero V1C execution consumers. Residual caveat: runtime deployment must strictly enforce host file permissions on the root-owned UID policy before daemon initialization.
